name: diff-viewer-turn
notes: The turn-diff mode of the SAME renderer, reached by a different opener (`/changes` -> diff_viewer.open_turn instead of open). Two scenarios on one render function is deliberate: the two modes build different state and different header text, so a regression that swapped them would be invisible with only one baselined. The empty-state sentence is asserted because 'no changes captured' is the most common real state and the most likely to regress.
